policies.title: PRC ordinary passports: current statutory Singapore visa exemption
policies.summary: Singapore's current visa-exemption Order directly exempts a non-citizen holding a valid ordinary passport issued by the People's Republic of China.
conditions: The current Order commenced on 1 July 2026 and expressly revoked the prior Immigration (Exemption from Singapore Visa) Order (O 4).

The exemption is limited to a valid ordinary passport issued by the People's Republic of China. The Order's scheduled diplomatic, official, service, public-affairs and other special-document classes are not ordinary-passport rules.
The paragraph excludes a non-citizen already holding a valid pass that permits multiple entries into Singapore; that residence or pass-holder situation is outside the ordinary short-visitor baseline.
The Order does not state a permitted visit duration. Admission and the period of the electronic Visit Pass remain determined at the checkpoint, independently of visa exemption.
The current law changes the governing instrument rather than the displayed access result; Chinese ordinary passports were already recorded as visa-free under current Singapore mission guidance.
